text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress effectively. Breaking a project into milestones allows you to monitor achievements along the way, while defining deliverables ensures everyone understands what must be completed. It is also important to align all stakeholders early in the process so that expectations are shared and supported. When these elements work together, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to achieve the desired results on time.
